start: HQ app, signed in with a MettleUp Google account

steps.action: Open the home list of gyms
user_sees: Every gym, newest first, with members, check-ins in 7 and 30 days, money this and last month, staff count, live devices, last activity
must_not: A refusal for a correct HQ sign-in

user_sees: A new row 'view_all_gyms' with the HQ person's email and address
must_not: The look missing from the log

user_sees: Its counts, its owners' names and mobiles, the last 20 HQ actions on it
must_not: The staff list or any member

user_sees: Database size against 500 MB and totals across gyms

steps.action: Page back through the audit log, filtered to one gym
user_sees: 100 rows a page, older each page
must_not: Rows of other gyms in the filtered view

start: A gym's own admin app key or a member app key

steps.action: Call any HQ read with it
user_sees: Refused before any HQ code runs

steps.action: Call with no verified email, or for a gym that does not exist
must_not: A look with no name written down

steps.action: Try to change or delete an audit row
must_not: An audit row changed or removed younger than 2 years

user_sees: The look itself added as a row 'view_audit'
must_not: Looks at the log left out

steps.action: Read what is shown about the gym
user_sees: Only totals and the owners' business contact

steps.action: The gym's owner opens 'MettleUp access' in the admin app
user_sees: The support looks inside windows they can see
must_not: HQ claiming every look is shown to the owner when plain gym views are not
